mapper.select: SELECT p.*,c.course_name,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id=p.id) question_count FROM exam_paper p JOIN sys_course c ON c.id=p.course_id WHERE p.id=#{id}

SELECT pq.id,pq.paper_id,pq.question_id,q.question_content,q.question_type,q.difficulty,pq.question_score FROM exam_paper_question pq JOIN exam_question q ON q.id=pq.question_id WHERE pq.paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY pq.id
